episode.method: Fold episode-block bootstrap (20000 draws) + conditional temporal-edge permutation (20000 draws) on the real portfolio engine; 98h linkage.

temporal_edge_permutation.method: conditional permutation: crash bars redrawn from the real RSI(21)<20 census with observed per-symbol multiplicity preserved; exact validated portfolio replay
limitations: Exact null space fully enumerated; resampled with replacement to reach the preregistered draw floor (standard Monte-Carlo permutation).
